C15 is closest because it addresses financial entitlements of appointees upon separation and assigns judgment to the agency concerned, but it does not share the child's leave-record requirements, doubtful-claim referral mechanism, or reporting to the Bureau of the Budget. C04 concerns Presidential appointees and agency-administered personnel procedures, while C17 concerns employee expense payments and administrative settlement, but these are only adjacent subject matter and routine machinery. The child's distinctive sequence—restrict terminal-leave payments, require formal or personal leave records, refer doubtful cases to the Comptroller General or General Accounting Office, and notify the Bureau of the Budget—does not appear in any candidate.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"no person appointed by the President shall, upon leaving the Government, receive payment for unused annual leave except upon a clear showing of entitlement","parent_excerpt":"The expenses of return travel and transportation upon separation from service shall be allowed ... but shall not be allowed unless such persons selected for appointment ... shall have served for a minimum period","explanation":"C15 has the closest substantive overlap: a conditional financial entitlement for appointees upon separation.
